native_minecraft_tests.note: Same four headless test names fail in the earlier addon-disabled baseline. Cause unresolved; not established live-server bugs.

dimensions.native_mode: Follow frequency.crossDimensional automatically; physical sites, all native XYZ scaling, native dimensional attenuation, foci ignored.
dimensions.focus_mode: Only a focus adds a foreign-world site while native cross-dimensional radio is disabled.
dimensions.mapping: home X/Z * home coordinate scale / target coordinate scale
dimensions.attenuation: Native base-loss reach gate, then travel with dimensionalInterference (halved for AM).
dimensions.native_speaker: Focus output localizes carrier origin only; ownership, bytes, activity, worst noise and both counts retained.

power.formula: current tower nominal power * current catalyst strength * 0.9 ^ (decay count - 1)
power.ordinary: Increment total visits and decay count.
power.amplifier: Increment total visits, reset decay to 1.
power.budget: Configured maximum total visits also applies across amplifiers, wires and conversions.
power.audio: Retain worst interference; amplifier cannot repair audio.
power.catalyst: Always required; native registered item with finite positive strength.
power.antenna: Verified positive native score on supported core; native receiver base gain retained.

transponder.mount: Directly atop Relay, mutually exclusive with six-card Bank.
transponder.required: Tuned left plus at least one tuned right.
transponder.simplex: Left to both selected right channels.
transponder.duplex: Left to rights; either right to left.
transponder.mode_switch: Empty-hand front center display; card boundary excluded.
transponder.persistent: Ordered card policy and mode update unloaded Relay records and survive pending entity restoration.

routing.nodes: Directed channel input/output ports over immutable tower snapshots.
routing.dominance: Same port; no greater total visits, no greater decay, no worse noise.
routing.amplifier_detours: Retain higher-total routes when lower decay makes them useful.
routing.route_cache_key: Entry port, previous total, previous decay, pruning mode; scoped by network revision and native dimensional mode.
routing.live_inputs: Packet ingress noise and receiver position/reception are not cached.
routing.source_copies: Materialize selected ordinary delivery only; independent copies for custom callbacks.

regressions.fixture_note: Native speaker fixture removes itself from both its container and global map, avoiding stale validation of a reused router ID.

appearance.attachment_item_and_transponder_models: Code-native meshes using existing 16px palette and native Minecraft textures.
